snippet.title: Fading Serenades - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: Watch the Release Date Trailer for Fading Serenades, a casual action-adventure game developed by Bernie Wick. Players will explore a serene village to deliver packages, complete tasks, and fulfill the needs of the public. Explore a variety of stories in Fading Serenades, launching on October 23 for PC (Steam) with a demo available now.
